content: Threshold/notification patterns (Brink, AIQuota, CodexBar READMEs — three independent apps agree): notifications when a limit fills up, plus a reset notification scheduled for the reset instant so it fires even when the app is idle (Brink); configurable per-service alert thresholds (AIQuota); optional session quota notifications (CodexBar); color scale green-yellow-red by usage (Brink rings, CodexBar meter icons); burndown chart from recorded snapshots with capture time (CodexBar).
